role: UI Team Leader; Software Subteam Mentor
summary: Leads the UI team for the university's Lunabotics robot and mentors incoming software engineers.
highlights: Contributed to a 1st-place finish among 47 university teams at NASA's Lunabotics Competition by developing the competition web UI and supporting breadcrumb-based autonomous navigation.
Engineered a real-time ROS node in C++ to monitor IMU accelerometer data, alerting drivers to dangerous conditions and triggering a software safety stop when thresholds were exceeded.

Developed a web-based driving interface connected to an NVIDIA Jetson through WebSockets and a custom ROS networking node, streaming camera views, robot temperature, and autonomy status during competition.
Mentored 8 incoming software engineers through C++ and ROS technical onboarding, increasing year-over-year software-team retention by 10%.
